title: Prices go up in 7 days. Get your Disrupt ticket now.
originalTitle: Prices go up in 7 days. Get your Disrupt ticket now.
content:
7:00 AM PDT · September 19, 2026

Our current ticket pricing window for TechCrunch Disrupt 2026 ends next Friday, Sept. 25 at 11:59 p.m. PT. After that, prices increase. Save up to $200 when you register before the deadline.

Why Disrupt?

From October 13-15 at San Francisco’s Moscone West, 10,000+ founders, investors, operators, and tech leaders will walk into TechCrunch Disrupt 2026 looking for companies to invest in, products to use, partners to work with, and technologies worth paying attention to.

At Disrupt, you can:

  • Learn what’s next from leaders across AI, fintech, robotics, infrastructure, and more.
  • Meet the right people through 1:1 meetings, AI-powered matchmaking, and dedicated networking opportunities.
  • Find your next opportunity in the Expo Hall, the Startup Battlefield 200, and across the Disrupt community.
  • Get practical insights on building, funding, and scaling a company in today’s tech landscape.
  • Build connections that move your business forward with founders, investors, operators, partners and potential customers.

Whether you’re building, investing, scaling, or looking for what’s next, Disrupt puts the people and ideas you need in the same room.

October 13–15. Moscone West, San Francisco. Don’t miss out.

1 week. Then prices go up.

Don’t wait until the last minute and pay more for the same three days.

Get your ticket by Sept. 25 at 11:59 p.m. PT and save up to $200.
